pages.caption: ПОВАР / COOK — the cook's cabin door. russian and english on one stencil, sprayed yellow.
the cook's stencil itself, the letters cut out of plain paper.
3 MX / 3 ENG. — third motorman and third engineer, the junior crew of the engine room.
CH. ENG. / CMX — chief engineer and chief motorman: the heads of the engine room.
2 MX / 2 ENG. — second motorman, second engineer. sprayed over a port security form.
EL. ENG. / 3MX — the electrical engineer, who looks after everything wired on board.
the EL. ENG. stencil, its letters cut clean out.
ПРАКТИКАНТ / CADET — the cadet's cabin: a trainee sailor, at sea to learn.
the cadet's label sprayed, yellow and white.
MASTER — the master is the captain. the captain's cabin door.
МАТРОС 1 / A/B 1 — able seaman no. 1, a deckhand. stencil cut from a cargo-hold table.
SEC / THIRD — second and third officers, the watchkeepers on the bridge. the stencil.
2 MATE stencil, cut from a list of the ship's regulations.
2 MATE / 2 ПОМ — the second mate, in charge of charts and navigation. sprayed over a 2016 crew list.
BRIDGE MASTER — the captain's post on the bridge, where the ship is steered from.
the BRIDGE MASTER stencil, cut from the ship's garbage management plan.
